evals.name: read-once-cache-no-pdf-rereads
evals.prompt: I need you to compare resume-v9.pdf and resume-v10-final.pdf and tell me what changed in v10. Then also pull the client case status from the client agreement PDF (/opt/private/coach/docs.local/client-agreement.pdf). After that, summarize all three for me.
